title: OpenPipeStress Result Export Schema 0.2.0 — CANDIDATE
description: Route-A candidate revision V4. A strict host-JSON representability phase and complete structural/type schema phase precede all semantic relations.

AnalysisStatus.description: Automatic software-emitted analysis statuses allowed in result exports. Human project acceptance is external and hash-bound.

ResultTraceLink.description: Optional per-value trace link for result-boundary evidence. This records references across existing governed boundaries only; it does not infer missing provenance or expand solver behavior.

source_field_path.description: Optional field-scalar path within source_ref. When present, target_field_path is also required.

target_field_path.description: Optional field-scalar path within target_ref. When present, source_field_path is also required.

UnitPreservationWitness.description: Optional result-envelope witness proving an exported result row preserves its source value, unit, and dimension without conversion. This is local unit I/O evidence only and does not create a cross-boundary trace chain.

source_result_refs.description: Ordered compatibility projection equal in presence and value to source_record.source_result_refs; enforced by the mandatory runtime validator.

ResultMetadata.description: Compatibility projection equal to source_record.metadata when metadata exists; equality is an adapter acceptance check.

ResultSetType.description: First-class result-set categories for governed result-boundary evidence. These categories classify exported evidence only; they do not define solver behavior, rule checks, report rendering, CLI/API behavior, or professional conclusions.

NativeResultMetadata.description: Exact five-string metadata from the native ResultItem. These strings are preserved, not normalized semantics.

$comment: K8 candidate revision V4; public schema version remains candidate 0.2.0.
